title: Spain Andalusia Crop fields
description:
SIGPAC is the Geographic Information System for the Identification of Agricultural Plots ,
created through collaboration between the Spanish Agricultural Guarantee Fund (FEGA) and
the different Autonomous Communities, within the scope of their territories, as an element
of the Integrated Management and Control System of the direct aid regimes. It has the character
of a public register of administrative profile, and contains updated information on the
plots that may benefit from community aid related to the surface area, providing graphic
support for these and their subdivisions (ENCLOSURES) with defined agricultural uses or
developments.

This collection holds 1 edition (2025), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_an/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2025). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:25830). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_an/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_province_code
table:columns.description: Province code (source column `CD_PROV`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_municipality_code
table:columns.description: Municipality code (source column `CD_MUN`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Spain Andalusia — latest edition (2025) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2025/es_an-2025.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.5, 1 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.

links.title: Pursuant to Law 37/2007 of 16 November on the reuse of public sector information and Law 3/2013 of 24 July approving the Statistical and Cartographic Plan of Andalusia 2013-2017, the geographic information of SIGPAC is made available to the public.
